test_simulate_config_bridge: test the _simulate_config_bridge function with a config dict and initial env to verify env var outcomes
test_top_level_cwd_alias: test the TestTopLevelCwdAlias class to verify top-level cwd and backend aliases map to TERMINAL_CWD and TERMINAL_ENV
test_nested_terminal_precedence: test that nested terminal.cwd and terminal.backend take precedence over top-level cwd and backend aliases
test_messaging_cwd_fallback: test that missing cwd config falls back to MESSAGING_CWD env var or defaults to /root
test_placeholder_cwd_skip: test that terminal.cwd placeholder values like dot, auto, and cwd do not clobber pre-set TERMINAL_CWD env vars
